title: Implement Parameterized Queries for Banking Operations
problem_statement: Legacy VB6 code uses string concatenation for SQL construction, creating critical SQL injection vulnerabilities in balance check and deposit operations
risk_if_unaddressed: Account takeover, unauthorized balance access, fraudulent deposits, data corruption
suggested_approach: Replace string concatenation with parameterized queries using SqlCommand.Parameters in C# modernization
success_criteria: All SQL queries use parameterized inputs
Static analysis confirms no string concatenation in SQL

provenance.evidence: rs.Open "SELECT Balance FROM tblCustomers WHERE AccountNo='" & txtAccountNo.Text & "'"

title: Add Input Validation for Financial Operations
problem_statement: Banking operations accept raw text input without validation for amount format, range, or type safety
risk_if_unaddressed: Invalid transactions, negative deposits, account number format attacks, system crashes
suggested_approach: Implement decimal validation for amounts, account number format validation, and range checks before database operations
success_criteria: All financial inputs validated before processing
Proper error messages for invalid inputs
Unit tests cover validation edge cases

provenance.evidence: txtAmount.Text used directly in SQL without validation

title: Implement Transaction Boundaries for Banking Operations
problem_statement: Deposit operations lack atomic transaction handling, risking data inconsistency in concurrent access scenarios
risk_if_unaddressed: Race conditions, partial updates, balance corruption, audit trail gaps
suggested_approach: Wrap deposit operations in database transactions with proper rollback handling and optimistic locking

provenance.evidence: Single UPDATE statement without transaction context

title: Design Authentication and Authorization Framework
problem_statement: Banking operations lack any visible authentication or authorization mechanisms, allowing unrestricted access
risk_if_unaddressed: Unauthorized account access, regulatory compliance violations, fraud exposure
suggested_approach: Implement OAuth2/JWT authentication with role-based authorization for banking operations
success_criteria: Account access restricted to authorized users
Audit logs track all access attempts

provenance.evidence: No authentication checks visible in banking operations
